{{Top|leg}}
'''Kralkeen Mining Concern''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company that operated on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:CtCS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Crunch the Claim Stealers}} on Tatooine</ref>

The company's surveyors searched for [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] all the way to the [[Mospic High Range/Legends|Mospic High Range]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] one of the company's competitors hired a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] to attack the surveyors once an ore vein had been found. Over a dozen workers had already been maimed or [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the company decided to hire a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to kill the gang members.
